5058194831554.sourceDescription:
Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic and Metal. Colour: Green. Stated size: 180 cm. Product weight: 4.6 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive green artificial Christmas tree designed to create a striking focal point for your holiday home display.
Durable construction combining plastic and metal materials ensures the tree maintains its shape and appearance over time.
Versatile decorative accessory that can be easily repositioned or adjusted within your arrangement to refresh the look.
Simple and modern design allows it to blend seamlessly with various interior styles while adding seasonal charm.
Guarantee - 1 month
Artificial christmas tree type: Pop up
Assembly required
With stand

7906816232754.sourceDescription:
Product Features
Classic christmas tree: Recreate a natural winter wonderland with this 5ft Christmas tree. Featuring 1524 PE and PVC tips and a 92 cm diameter, it delivers a beautifully balanced, lush and traditional profile in your holiday setting.
Automatic hinged setup: Featuring a sectioned trunk with pre-attached hinged tips that drop down automatically, this Christmas tree allows less time in shaping and more time enjoying the holidays (suggested shaping time: 25-45 minutes). The sectional build ensures compact off-season storage.
Flame-retardant tips: Flame-retardant PE and PVC tips help slow the spread of fire, offering added reassurance for seasonal decorating. Your family and pets can gather around this artificial Christmas tree and enjoy a warm, cosy holiday season.
Solid pine wood base: The stable pine wood base provides robust support for your Christmas tree while adding an elevated, textured aesthetic that complements natural holiday decor. The solid base assembles easily and stores compactly once festivities end.
Festive accent: This artificial Christmas tree serves as a versatile seasonal accent for your living room, office displays and holiday gatherings. It smoothly infuses an authentic forest touch and a vibrant holiday atmosphere into any indoor layout.
 
Please Note
All dimensions are measured manually, so slight variations of 2–3 cm may occur.
Actual colours may vary slightly depending on monitor settings and screen displays.
Decorative items shown in the pictures are not included in the delivery.

7984722962354.sourceDescription:
Celebrate Christmas with pastel macaron tones with this dreamy holiday tree.Boasting a soft pastel palette that departs from conventional deep green evergreens, this artificial fir offers whimsical romantic charm throughout your space. Loaded with 910 lush branch tips and vibrant PVC foliage, it forms a naturally full rounded silhouette; simply fluff the twigs to reveal rich dimensional texture. Pre-lit with 250 warm white LED bulbs and powered by a UKCA certified adapter, it casts steady soft illumination that highlights the pastel foliage and fills your space with immersive festive warmth. Featuring a 3 section hinged frame and folding metal stand, the tree sets up quickly, and included gloves protect your hands while shaping branches. Constructed from 100% new PVC material, this 6 ft tree maintains its beautiful appearance season after year, with flame-retardant, anti-fading, non-allergic and smell-free properties for worry-free indoor holiday decorating. Note: Ornaments are not included.

Warm White Radiance: Soft warm white glow emanates from this pre-lit Christmas tree, powered by 140/190 LED bulbs. Tucked hidden light wires weave neatly through branches, while a UL certified adapter offers safe, consistent power to elevate your festive ambiance.
Reliable Material: Made of high-quality PE and PVC materials, this hinged Xmas tree preserves its bright festive charm season after season with anti-fading performance. 5052532178554.sourceDescription:
Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display. The burgundy finish and velvet construction give them a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Velvet. Colour: Burgundy. Stated size: 11 x 13 cm. Quantity: 12 pack.
Velvet construction provides a rich, festive finish for your Christmas display.
Includes 12 burgundy hanging ornaments to create a coordinated seasonal look.
Compact 11 x 13 cm size allows for versatile placement on tree branches.
Burgundy velvet colour adds defined detail and visual interest to decorations.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 12x Christmas tree decorations
Hanger included

Open the package and check all tools and drill gems.

Match the symbol codes on the wooden ornament plate with the corresponding diamond color bags.

5014555701454.variantName: 12-Piece Gold Coloured Glass Bauble Set - Four Mixed Designs
5014555701454.sourceDescription:
This 12-piece gold coloured glass bauble set brings a cohesive, colour-led look to any Christmas tree. The set includes four distinctive designs – plain round baubles, ribbed round baubles, textured pinecone baubles, and elongated ice drop baubles – giving your tree a layered, styled finish that a single-shape set simply can't achieve. 

The gold coloured glass catches the light across four different surfaces: textured shapes catch the light and sparkle. The plain rounds give a gentler shine, so the tree doesn't look busy. The result is a warm, glistening finish rather than a flat, single-note metallic. Each bauble comes with a 16cm hanging cord for easy, fuss-free hanging. 

The mixed designs add real visual interest at different levels of the tree – rounds at the tips, pinecones mid-branch, ice drops on longer branches for maximum movement and sparkle. Sold as a set of 12 with hanging cords included. 

Ideal for: Classic gold and red Christmas tree themes, warm metallic and neutral colour schemes, and mixed-design tree displays.

5052532155654.sourceDescription:
Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Its green finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

Double Sided Design
The two sided design gives you a choice of usable surfaces or presentation. Turn the item to the side that suits the intended arrangement.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Colour: Green. Product measurements: length 29 cm, width 29.5 cm, height 1 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.

Compact dimensions of 29 cm by 29.5 cm make it ideal for small spaces and detailed arrangements.

Solar-Powered Lucky Waving Cat: Feng Shui Decor & Gift
Cute Design for Happiness & Stress Relief
This lucky cat features a charming profile design and smiling eyes, exuding happiness and auspicious energy. Just having it around helps lift your spirits, put you in a good mood, and ease daily stress—adding a warm, cheerful touch to any space it’s placed in.
Feng Shui Waving Paw for Wealth & Good Fortune
Following Feng Shui traditions, the cat’s raised paw carries meaningful symbolism: a raised right paw is said to attract money, while a raised left paw is believed to draw in customers and opportunities. Display it in your living room, office, front desk, or hallway facing outdoors to welcome positive energy and wealth into your life.
Traditional Chinese Style for Modern Spaces
This lucky waving cat blends traditional Chinese decorative elements with a modern look, making it a perfect fit for 21st-century homes and offices. It’s not just a decor piece—it’s also thought to bring health, wealth, and wisdom, letting good luck accompany you in daily life and every endeavor.
Exquisite Craft as a Thoughtful Gift
With its exquisite craftsmanship, the lucky cat looks funny and adorable, making it a wonderful gift for various occasions. It’s a unique eastern-inspired piece, ideal for Christmas, birthdays, or any holiday. It’s especially great for cat-loving kids or anyone who appreciates meaningful, lucky-themed gifts.
Feng Shui Mascot for Home Wealth Corner
As a classic Feng Shui mascot, placing it in the “wealth corner” of your home (a key area in Feng Shui for attracting prosperity) helps maximize its positive energy. It’s believed to bring abundant, vibrant energy into your space—serving as a motivating, encouraging sight that keeps you feeling upbeat and hopeful.
Auspicious Design for Joy & Stress Relief: Featuring a cute cat profile and smiling eyes, this decor piece is filled with happiness and auspicious meaning, helping to lift your mood, bring joy, and ease stress whenever you see it.
Fengshui Waving Cat for Wealth & Customers: As a classic Fengshui item, its raised right paw is believed to attract money, while a raised left paw draws in customers—simply display it in your living room, office, front desk, or hallway facing outdoors to welcome prosperity.
Traditional Chinese Style with Blessings: Blending traditional Chinese aesthetics with modern decor needs, this waving cat decoration is meant to bring you blessings of health, wealth, and wisdom, accompanying you with good luck in all your endeavors.
Perfect Lucky Gift for All Occasions: With exquisite craftsmanship and an adorable, funny appearance, this lucky cat is an excellent Eastern-inspired gift—ideal for Christmas, birthdays, or any holiday, especially for cat-loving kids or anyone who appreciates symbolic good luck items.
Powerful Fengshui Mascot for Abundant Energy: As a Fengshui mascot, placing it in the "wealth corner" of your home maximizes its effect. It radiates vibrant, abundant energy that inspires and encourages you, symbolizing a life of prosperity and vitality.

5096042276454.baseName: LED Christmas wreath - Light-up door wreath - 30 warm white LEDs and timer for a hallway or mantel, Green, red and white, 45 cm
5096042276454.variantName: LED Christmas wreath - Light-up door wreath - 30 warm white LEDs and timer for a hallway or mantel, Green, red and white, 45 cm
5096042276454.sourceDescription:
Pine cones and red berries stand out from snow-dusted needles on this 45 cm wreath. It projects about 12 cm, a useful detail when measuring a door recess. Thirty warm white LEDs and a timer take care of the evening display.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. The pale tips give the arrangement its own highlights in daylight. Against dark paint the snowy edge is easy to follow, while a lighter background draws attention to the darker details tucked further into the design.

Small red berries show especially clearly against a simple backdrop. If you want to tie the wreath into a larger Christmas scheme, repeat their red in a nearby ornament and let the foliage provide the quieter colour. Choose the start of the lighting period with the room's usual evening routine in mind. It is worth checking the controls while the wreath is still within reach, before moving it to its final position.

From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail. Warm white light works well alongside wood, brass and cream finishes.

A lit wreath can provide the evening detail in a hallway where there is little space for a tree. Keeping the surface below it simple lets the outline show up after dark and leaves room for the everyday use of the entrance. Think about access to the controls before choosing the final position. Leave enough room to reach the switch comfortably while keeping the front of the arrangement clear, especially if you plan to change the lighting during the evening.
Features 30 warm white LEDs with a built-in timer for convenient automated display.
Decorative design includes snow-dusted needles, pine cones and red berries for festive detail.
Compact 45 cm diameter size is ideal for hallways, mantels or door recesses.
Combines natural daytime texture with evening illumination for versatile seasonal decor.
Comes with Timer function

5056713294354.variantName: 60cm LED Frosted Christmas Wreath with Warm and Cool LED Lights
5056713294354.sourceDescription:
Bring crisp illumination and metallic sparkle to your festive home with this 40cm pre lit Christmas wreath. Gold and silver glitter foliage, pine cones and baubles frame cream flowers with gold centres and delicately edged petals.

Display the wreath on a front door, hang it on a feature wall or place it flat on a dining table as a seasonal centrepiece. The coordinated floral design remains decorative when the lights are switched off.

Cool white LEDs highlight the shimmering details, while selectable warm white lighting creates a softer atmosphere. Both colours are included, alongside 8 light modes offering steady, slow, flashing and alternating effects. Control the lighting using the button on the battery pack.

The automatic timer provides 6 hours of illumination followed by 18 hours off, repeating daily while enabled. Requires 3 AA batteries, not included.

Suitable for indoor and outdoor display. Shelter is recommended for prolonged outdoor use. Keep the battery compartment securely closed and do not submerge the battery pack in water.

Although the updated finish improves glitter adhesion, a little loose glitter may still be released during unpacking and arranging. Unpack over a protected surface and handle gently.

Includes one wreath, approximately 40cm in diameter.

This wreath is built on a sturdy base, intricately woven with natural pinecones and festive embellishments. Each design offers a unique combination of elements, from frosted berries and bright apples to elegant silver and gold accents. The wreath includes a strong jute loop, making it simple to hang securely on any standard hook or nail right out of the box. Its durable construction ensures it can be stored and reused for many holiday seasons to come.
Imagine this wreath greeting your guests as they arrive, setting a warm and inviting tone for your home during the holidays. Whether it’s hanging proudly on your front door, adding festive cheer above a fireplace, or bringing seasonal colour to your hallway, it effortlessly complements your existing Christmas decorations. It’s a timeless piece that brings the classic look of a winter forest into your home.

Halloween Decoration
This Halloween decoration adds a decorative detail to the chosen display. The brown finish and fabric and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Halloween.

Pumpkin Design
The pumpkin design gives the display a recognisable seasonal theme. Use it as a focal detail within an autumn or Halloween arrangement, pairing it with suitable surrounding decorations for a coordinated finish.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Fabric and Plastic. Colour: Brown. Stated size: 156 x 107 x 274 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Distinctive pumpkin design adds a recognisable seasonal theme to your Halloween display.
Constructed from durable fabric and plastic for a defined appearance that lasts through the season.
Versatile brown finish coordinates easily with existing autumn decor or stands alone as a focal point.
Generous size of 156 x 107 x 274 cm makes a bold statement piece for indoor or outdoor arrangements.
Guarantee - 1 month

It's fitted with LED lights for a soft glow when it's dark. Made from weather-resistant polyester, it is suitable for both indoor or outdoor use. Comes with three guy ropes and six ground stakes to keep it stable and secure in the ground. Celebrate Christmas the right way this year.
CUTE: Happy gingerbread man wearing a santa hat design - a fun and way to welcome both children and adults guests into your home this Christmas.
LED LIGHTS: Built-in, they light up the area, creating an extra-fun effect with a beautiful glow during the night.
INSTANT SETUP: Automatically inflates once plugged into the electric - it is fun and easy to set up. Deflates just as quickly too.
DURABLE: Made from weather-resistant and IP44 rated polyester, can be used outdoors safely. DIMENSIONS: 183H x 110W x 70Dcm.
INCLUDED ACCESSORIES: Built-in air blower, 3(m) power cable, three guy ropes and six ground stakes to keep it attached in the ground.
• Overall Dimensions: 110W x 70D x 183Hcm; • Material: Polyester Fabric; • Input Voltage: 220-240V / 50Hz; • Output Voltage: 12V DC / 1000mA; • Air blower Motor: 9.6W / 0.8A; • Power Cable Length: 3m; • Certification: IP44; NOTE: Please don't place it outdoor in hard rain or snow!

5021196842354.variantName: St Helens Home and Garden Inflatable Father Christmas with LED Lights 170cm Height
5021196842354.sourceDescription:
Delight your family and neighbours this festive season with the charming 170cm inflatable Father Christmas from St Helens Home & Garden. Everything you need is supplied, simply plug him in and watch him inflate, it couldn't be easier. The Father Christmas features internal pre-assembled LED lights to make Christmas that little bit more magical. Supplied with an internal fan, 12V power adaptor, safety ropes and 2 pegs to help anchor it to the ground in inclement weather, the base is also weighted for extra safety, a zip compartment allows you to add extra weight if necessary. When the sad day arrives and Christmas is over simply fold him flat and pack him away in his box until next year. Made from 100% polyester. For either indoor or outdoor use.

5056141040554.sourceDescription:
Create a polished seasonal display with this pre-lit snow flocked artificial Christmas tree range, available in 4ft, 5ft, 7ft and 10ft sizes. Each tree is designed with a winter-inspired frosted finish and hinged branches to help make assembly and decorating more straightforward. The mixed leaf construction and full shape give a rich festive look that suits living rooms, hallways and other indoor spaces where a refined Christmas centrepiece is wanted.

Integrated cool white LED lights add instant sparkle without the need for separate string lights, while the light settings let you choose a look that suits your décor. Depending on size, the trees offer either 140, 180, 320 or 540 LEDs and include multiple lighting modes such as steady on, flashing, twinkle/flash, slow fade, sequential and combination effects. Made from PVC-based materials with a sturdy stand included in the larger variants’ supplied design details, this reusable tree family offers an elegant way to style the season year after year.
